title: Help-and-Recover One Pass Away
description: A defender one pass away practises stepping into the gap to help, then recovering to their own man the instant the ball swings their way.

content.objective: Help in the gap when the ball drives, then recover to the original matchup before the pass arrives.
content.setup: Two offensive players and their defenders set up with one driving lane open.
instructions: The ball handler drives toward the gap near the help defender.
The help defender steps in to discourage the drive without fully committing.
As soon as the ball is passed back out, the helper sprints to recover to their own man.
Rotate roles so every defender practises both jobs.
coachingPoints: Help with a slide, not a lunge, keeping balance to recover.
Time the recovery to arrive before the pass, not after.
Communicate 'I'm helping' so teammates can adjust.
commonMistakes: Fully committing to the helper's job and losing the recover.
Recovering too late, leaving the shooter wide open.
Standing upright instead of staying in a low stance.
content.safety: Keep the driving lane realistic but not full-speed contact.
